name: Caroxazone
summary: Caroxazone (Surodil, Timostenil) is an antidepressant which was formerly used for the treatment of depression but is now no longer marketed. It acts as a reversible monoamine oxidase inhibitor (RIMA) of both MAO-A and MAO-B subtypes, with five-fold preference for the latter.

pharmacology.text: It acts as a reversible monoamine oxidase inhibitor (RIMA) of both MAO-A and MAO-B subtypes, with five-fold preference for the latter.

uses.text: Caroxazone (Surodil, Timostenil) is an antidepressant which was formerly used for the treatment of depression but is now no longer marketed.

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it in detail. Drugs of its class, the MAO inhibitors, can cause dizziness on standing, sleep problems, dry mouth and nausea, and can trigger dangerous rises in blood pressure and serotonin syndrome.
sideEffects.zh: 關於它的詳細資料很少。同類的單胺氧化酶抑制劑可能造成起身時頭暈、睡眠問題、口乾與噁心，也可能引發危險的血壓升高與血清素症候群。
sideEffects.zhHans: 关于它的详细数据很少。同类的单胺氧化酶抑制剂可能造成起身时头晕、睡眠问题、口干与恶心，也可能引发危险的血压升高与血清素症候群。

fact.en: Caroxazone belongs to a small group of reversible MAO inhibitors. Older MAO inhibitors such as phenelzine disable the enzyme permanently, so the body has to build new enzyme before their effect wears off.
fact.zh: Caroxazone 屬於少數可逆性單胺氧化酶抑制劑之一。較早的單胺氧化酶抑制劑如苯乙肼會永久破壞這種酵素，所以身體必須重新製造酵素，藥效才會消退。
fact.zhHans: Caroxazone 属于少数可逆性单胺氧化酶抑制剂之一。较早的单胺氧化酶抑制剂如苯乙肼会永久破坏这种酵素，所以身体必须重新制造酵素，药效才会消退。
